lines.text: David takes refuge in the cave of Adullam, and about four hundred distressed and indebted men rally around him.
David leaves his parents with the king of Moab, then the prophet Gad tells him to go to Judah.
Under the tamarisk tree at Ramah, Saul hears Doeg the Edomite say he saw David come to Ahimelech at Nob.
Saul summons Ahimelech and condemns him, and when the guards obey, Doeg kills eighty-five priests.

wrong_details.true: the king's servants would not lift a hand to strike the priests

lines.text: Abiathar escapes to David and reports the killings, and David promises that he will be safe with him.
